name: rrcatto/cattophp
description: A Symfony bundle with the foundations of a web application: sign-in with two-step codes, settings over .env, roles and permissions, an activity log, error pages, security headers and mail.

suggest.dompdf/dompdf: For the documents module: documents and pages drawn as PDFs
suggest.geocoder-php/geoip2-provider: For the network lookup: an address's country and place through Geocoder (MaxMind's GeoLite2 databases by default, another Geocoder provider by configuration) and its network
suggest.omnipay/common: For the payments module: payment gateways through Omnipay, their keys in Settings (with the gateway package, such as rrcatto/omnipay-stitch-express)
suggest.symfony/http-client: For the Telegram, identity verification and mailing modules: Telegram's, Didit's and catto-mail's APIs
